mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_log (user_id, chat_type, user_input, ai_reply, emotion, source, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{chatType}, #{userInput}, #{aiReply}, #{emotion}, #{source}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, chat_type, user_input, ai_reply, emotion, source, create_time FROM chat_log WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT id, user_id, chat_type, user_input, ai_reply, emotion, source, create_time FROM chat_log ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
